description: This file contains a report generation script for bank remittance in the ERPNext payroll module, including functions to fetch payroll data, salary slips, bank accounts, and employee bank details, and to generate a report with relevant payroll and bank information.

methods.name: get_payroll_entries
methods.description: Retrieves payroll entries filtered by bank accounts and date range.

methods.name: get_salary_slips
methods.description: Fetches salary slips associated with payroll entries and maps debit accounts.

methods.name: get_emp_bank_ifsc_code
methods.description: Retrieves IFSC codes for employees in salary slips.

methods.name: set_company_account
methods.description: Associates payroll entries with their respective company bank accounts.
